output.sql: SELECT method AS payment_method, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM marts.fct_payments WHERE paid_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND paid_at < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY method ORDER BY method;
output.explanation: Groups fct_payments by method and counts payments and sums amounts for paid_at dates within calendar year 2025 (inclusive start, exclusive end). No status filter is applied because fct_payments has no status column to define a valid payment.
